name: Enoch
description: Man living at the time before the Flood

points: “And Enoch lived sixty and five years, and begat Methuselah”: the man that lived the longest on the earth, the one in the video with the sword and the fire.

note.label: Good And Evil | Generation To Generation: From Beginning To End

points: And Jared begat Enoch. Wait a minute: didn't Cain have a son named Enoch too? And Enoch walked with God, just like Noah walked with God. And he was not; for God took him: he got taken up like Elijah did.

note.label: As in the Days of Noah: Past & Present

points: The chapter abbreviates to one named son in each generation for a reason: it is tracing the line of the sons of God, from Seth through Enos, Cainan, Mahalaleel, Jared, Enoch, Methuselah, Lamech, and Noah.

note.label: Popular Persuasions: Fighting Against Heaven Defending Earth

points: “And Enoch walked with God after he begat Methuselah three hundred years, and begat sons and daughters”. There’s a bunch of sons and daughters out here, but the ones that are named are the most important ones.

note.label: Good And Evil | Generation To Generation: From Beginning To End

points: Enoch walked with God, and he was not, for God took him: God took him up in a chariot; he did not die like normal mortals die.

note.label: Popular Persuasions: Fighting Against Heaven Defending Earth

points: Enoch walked with God and was not: the Most High took him up, and Enoch did not taste death, the same way Elijah did not taste death.

note.label: Genesis 5: The Book of the Generations of Adam

points: “And Enoch walked with God: and he was not; for God took him.” How did he take him? He took him up the same way he took up Elijah.

Remember, Cain had Enoch and built a city called Enoch in the land of Nod; that’s a wicked Enoch. Then Irad, then down the line Lamech, and Lamech had Jabal and Jubal and Tubal–cain. Keep that in mind.

note.label: Good And Evil | Generation To Generation: From Beginning To End

points: Which was the son of Enoch, which was the son of Jared: two. Mahalaleel: three. Cainan: four. Enos, Seth: seven from Adam.

note.label: Lo, I Come In The Volume Of The Book

points: By faith Enoch was translated that he should not see death: taken up the same way Elijah was taken up. Before his translation he had this testimony, that he pleased God.

note.label: As in the Days of Noah: Past & Present

points: And Enoch also, the seventh from Adam: so Enoch was way back with Adam. The seventh from Adam.

Prophesied of these, saying, Behold, the Lord cometh with ten thousands of his saints: so Enoch prophesied the Lord coming with 10,000 of his saints. So Enoch was with the Lord. He prophesied of the Lord in the time of Adam.

note.label: Lo, I Come In The Volume Of The Book
